light:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: light-theme machine concept illustration for a creative developer portfolio design document, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: a charming, extremely simple small kinetic machine, near-monochrome paper and black ink, a slightly angled orthographic view. Large shallow rectangular open-front casing with rounded corners and two clearly visible meshing gears; exactly one small crank attached to a gear driving a short connecting rod and a horizontal slider on a rail below. A black electrical cable runs from the machine's left side to a separate wall socket at the far left. Connected plug and socket must both be visible, with no other props. Machine centered with ample negative space; every part inside the image.
Style: flat shaded cartoon 3D forms with clean bold dark outlines, shallow depth, soft ambient shadow, matte paper material. Industrial toy, precise and friendly, simplified mechanically coherent silhouette.
Palette: background exact warm paper #eeeee5, surface #e5e5da, ink #232520, muted gray #64685f. Nearly monochrome, no saturated accent colors.
Camera: fixed slight three-quarter orthographic angle looking into the open front; see front and a narrow right side and top. No perspective drama.
Constraints: no typography, no text, no logos, no people, no face, no screens, no decorations, no photorealism, no glossy chrome, no gradients in the background, no grainy hatching obscuring gears. The two gear wheels must visibly mesh and the slider must visibly connect to a crank. This is a conceptual illustration, not production geometry.
